original_ai_output.title_zh: 津巴布韦商人Wicknell Chivayo与妻子在直升机坠毁中遇难
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 津巴布韦知名商人Wicknell Chivayo及其妻子Lucy Muteke在哈拉雷以东的直升机坠毁事故中遇难，机上共六人全部死亡。警方称直升机在距首都约72公里的Marondera地区坠毁并起火，无人生还。警方在X平台简短声明中确认机上载有六人，但未能立即确认遇难者身份。

location.raw_text: Marondera area, about 72 kilometres from the capital (Harare)

key_facts.fact: 津巴布韦商人Wicknell Chivayo与妻子Lucy Muteke在直升机坠毁中遇难
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prominent Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo and his wife, Lucy Muteke, were among six people killed when a helicopter crashed east of Harare on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: 直升机在距首都约72公里的Marondera地区坠毁并起火，无人生还
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police said the aircraft went down in the Marondera area, about 72 kilometres from the capital, at around 3 p.m. local time. The helicopter burst into flames and there were no survivors.

key_facts.fact: 警方称机上载有六人，但未能立即确认遇难者身份
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police confirmed in a short statement on X that the helicopter was carrying six occupants but could not immediately confirm the identities of the victims.

key_facts.fact: 事故发生在哈拉雷以东，当地时间为周三下午3时左右
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: crashed east of Harare on Wednesday ... at around 3 p.m. local time

uncertainties: 遇难者身份尚未获警方立即确认
